observations.cosmic_density: Overlapping dust and gas layers soften the filament mesh and widen at neighboring clusters.
observations.dark_voids: Irregular dark pockets separate bright reaches in all three panels, with no exposed geometric guides.
observations.luminous_clusters: Small violet, cool-white and sparse warm clusters sit within the same diffuse field. The footer center visibly brightens and dims.
observations.vertical_continuity: The banner emits at the common opening x-coordinate. The same directed route crosses both text seams, from upper right toward the introduction, then down into the footer.
observations.phone_legibility: Actual GIF frames at 255 px retain the brightest path, connected wisps, negative space and footer pulse.
observations.fibonacci_structure: The original banner spiral remains. Density blur scales and motion period draw from Fibonacci values, with 21 frames at 130 ms.
observations.handoff_ontology: The diagram’s repeatable-workflow output diffuses into the same growth field, passes the two copy breaks, and gathers into a recurring terminal glow.
observations.continuous_motion: Each GIF repeats indefinitely with controlled last-to-first transitions and a dimension-matched reduced-motion still.
